what: After a build with -a, the running app still ran the previous code: start unpacks the karaf-offline tarball, which kept the old app jar, so the mail retry change was not visible in the tests.
why: build -a only refreshes the jar in ~/.m2; start uses the offline tarball. The catalog calls -a 'fast Java iteration' without this limit.
workaround: Ran full ./judo.sh build -i -M -F, then restarted and reran the spec.

what: kb_get of best-practices files without a section returns only the Intent paragraph and '(+7 more sections)'; kb_search hits of these files carry only the title as headingPath, so no section can be copied. Builder read the files from disk.
why: kb_get path-only answer for best-practices and blueprint files; :meta chunks have no sub-heading.
workaround: Read /Users/bmiller/Projects/judo-blueprint/catalog/... from disk.

what: Setting JUDO_PLATFORM_MAIL_SMTP_HOST and PORT in judo-karaf.env is not enough to get an EmailService OSGi service; the catalog deployment section does not say what else is needed.
why: Deployment doc incomplete for the mail service; the app started but the EmailService reference was null.
workaround: Shop sends mail through its own path; no EmailService used in this round.

what: The doc says the log SMTP server listens on logSmtpServerPort, default 1025; the shipped template says 10025.
why: Catalog default port does not match the shipped template.
workaround: Read only; log SMTP server was off.

what: The handlebars email template example compiles the template itself and passes it as htmlTemplate; the platform renders htmlTemplate again, so copying the example renders twice.
why: Example conflicts with the Email Service reference (htmlTemplate and plaintTemplate are Handlebars templates applied to model).
workaround: Shop renders subject and body itself, once.
catalog_paths: catalog/best-practices (handlebars-email-template.md, path not confirmed in session)

what: The catalog says check the artifact for the platform mail API but gives no coordinates; the working artifact is hu.blackbelt:osgi-email-api, compile-only.
why: Email integration doc has no dependency coordinates.
workaround: Added compile-only dependency in generator-overrides app pom fragment.
catalog_paths: catalog/agent-docs (email-service-integration, platform-email-template-service; exact paths not confirmed in session)

what: An additive migration gives an existing singleton ShopConfig row the new column defaults for some attributes but not for others (mailFrom empty); the code falls back to defaults on empty values.
why: Schema-evolution doc says an additive change needs no manual step; it does not say existing rows may keep empty values.
workaround: Code treats empty values as defaults.

what: Import of a CSV or JSON file threw NullPointerException on .isPresent(): an unsent optional transient binary input is null, not Optional.empty().
why: Catalog does not say optional operation members can be null.
workaround: StartImportCustomImplementation checks x != null && x.isPresent().

what: judo-cli create -t MimeType -n fails and the doc gives no working form; BinaryType mimeTypes accepts one value per create and --add is rejected too.
why: judo-cli.agent.md lacks the working create form for MIME types; found with create --schema.
workaround: create -t MimeType --ns webshop -s type=application -s subType=json; one MIME type per binary type.

what: Import of 5000 rows takes about 2.5 minutes; undo about 40 seconds; the Import runs card list does not refresh by itself.
why: Two DAO writes per product; UI has no auto-refresh for the run list.
workaround: Spec reopens the screen; Refresh button used.

what: Level 9b spec needed many fixes: missing waits for a field value, random SKU collisions, a wrong relative path to gen-import-products.py, a wrong file-upload selector, wrong column header assertions.
why: Test-design: assertions raced the background jobs and selectors were guessed.
workaround: Spec edits; screenshots checked; all 7 level9b tests passed.

what: The kb repeated-search guard fired 14 times in this round ('[kb] Repeated source searching, still no kb consult') while the builder ran build, log and test commands.
why: Guard counts bash source searches (grep, sed of logs) as source searching; it mis-fires on bulk log and build triage.
workaround: Ran kb_search when prompted; otherwise continued.

what: Carrier label sync: CarrierEvent staging entity, nightly sync at 02:00 and admin button call CarrierSyncService.sync(asOf); built and committed in 5e43f39.
why: Round 17 build.

what: Mails from templates with retry: MAX_ATTEMPTS 5, attempts due at fixed minutes after creation; committed in 5e43f39 with screenshots in a679fac.
why: Round 17 build.

what: Cart reminder with quiet period and nightly job; tested by the level9b spec and committed in 5e43f39.
why: Round 17 build.

what: 5000-row CSV or JSON import with run card, errors and undo; StartImportCustomImplementation checks CSV and JSON presence; committed in 5e43f39.
why: Round 17 build.

what: Land raw carrier status in a staging entity first, then process only new statuses.
why: Catalog pattern for external system data.

what: Own limit: cart touch only on add-to-cart and checkout; quantity edit and remove-line not treated as touch in this round.
why: Time; the interceptor route was not built.

what: Seed of the value 0 into the Unit enum column failed at runtime: Invalid enumeration value '0' of type webshop.types.Unit.
why: Builder seed script used 0 for an enum column.
workaround: sed changed the seed value to 1 and reseeded.

what: Volume seed: scripts/seed-volume-products.sh writes 50 000 products (VOL-nnnnn) straight into PostgreSQL; response timings checked with REST probes.
why: Round 18 build; timings not confirmed in this chunk.

what: Seed the 50 000 products directly into PostgreSQL instead of through the API.
why: Speed of the volume seed; no catalog entry used.

what: Faceted catalog search: CatalogSearch.java with native SQL for counts and SearchCustomImplementation for the ShopProductInfo search operation; CatalogHome.tsx rewritten.
why: Round 18 build.

what: Facet counts and aggregates use native SQL in one isolated service (CatalogSearch), because the DAO has no aggregate method.
why: Catalog says no DAO aggregate; native SQL only via JDBC DataSource.

what: Product versioning: ProductVersions.java, ProductVersionInterceptor, wiring into ChangePrices, checkout and quote.
why: Round 18 build.

what: Versioning is a convention: each version a full copy grouped by a container, one approved at a time.
why: Catalog says the platform has no versioning feature.

what: GDPR: PrivacyService erases via placeholder user, JsonOut exports the own data; PrivacyInfo operations exportMyData and eraseAccount added and built.
why: Round 18 build.

what: GDPR delete repoints kept references to one placeholder user, then hard-deletes the real user.
why: Catalog pattern: keep authored content, drop the person.

what: kb_get path-only on best-practices and blueprint files returns only the intro line ('(+7 more sections)'); the builder then read the files from disk (gdpr, product-versioning, custom-visual-element-override, data-snapshot-versioning).
why: Same kb_get limit as R17-1: path-only fetch returns the first section of best-practices files.
workaround: Read catalog files from disk.

what: kb_search '50000 products query performance index filter table paging' returned only a generic Performance Optimization section of production.md.
why: No hit on bulk query performance guidance for large tables.
workaround: Used other searches.

what: kb_search 'bulk json export actor own data download file' returned a Query Result Methods section, not the export pattern; builder read bulk-json-import-export.md from disk.
why: kb hit not relevant; the right file was only found by a second search.
workaround: Read catalog file from disk.

what: kb_search 'database index on attribute identifier unique model rdbms index filter column' returned an unrelated model-screen-layout section; builder fell back to grep of agent-docs.
why: No kb hit for declaring a database index.
workaround: grep in catalog/agent-docs (model, backend, deployment).

what: No documented way to declare a database index on a model attribute; the agent-docs list indexes only among RDBMS settings.
why: Catalog gap for indexes needed for 50 000 rows.
workaround: Checked the database for existing indexes with psql.

what: kb_search 'interceptor before after update old values' hit the interceptors Key patterns section; builder then read interceptors.md from disk for two line ranges.
why: kb section did not give the needed body; read from disk.
workaround: Read interceptors.md at offset 144 and 655.

what: filterBy(String) cannot navigate relations, and there is no inverse relation from CustomerAccount to its orders.
why: Catalog says the custom JQL filter does not support relation navigation.
workaround: Design around the limit with native SQL or separate lookups.

what: judo query esm --type failed with Unknown option '--type'; the working form uses --where fqn=.
why: Builder guessed the query option; judo-cli doc does not show query syntax clearly.
workaround: Used query esm --where fqn=... and --select.

what: create -t MenuItemAccess is refused: the item is created automatically; the CLI suggests create -t Access with --ns and --set target.
why: MenuItemAccess is generated with the TransferObjectType; create route not valid.
workaround: Used update on the auto-created item; label set with update.

what: update of a version info with --add feature failed: feature versionNumber is not a feature of ProductVersionInfo placeable here.
why: Unclear feature placement rules in the CLI for the generated view.
workaround: Changed the view fields instead.

what: judo delete --no-check on operations not in each view prints 'error Element not found' for Form and Table but 'removed' for View_Edit.
why: Delete loops over every view type; not all views have the operation.
workaround: Ignored the errors; validate --strict passed.

what: Build failed in frontend-react-model with 'Verify UI model is presented' after the exportMyData file operation was added; validate --strict passed; deleting the two operations from the Form and Table views and rebuilding gave BUILD SUCCESS.
why: Maven UI validation fails for an INSTANCE operation with file output while judo validate passes (cause not fully known).
workaround: Removed the file operations from the views, rebuilt.

what: With -DuseCache=true the frontend-react model step fails with an empty cause '{}: {}'; -DuseCache=false and -DvalidateModels=false give exit 0.
why: Build cache hides the real validation error in quick mode.
workaround: Ran mvnd install with -DuseCache=false -DvalidateModels=true to see the error.

what: Each build logs about 10 XMI ID COLLISION errors in e2e-model and frontend-react-model (ID reassigned between Action objects of TabularReferenceField actions).
why: Platform model transform reuses XMI IDs for tabular reference actions; probably pre-existing (also in build-r17-g).
workaround: None; build still succeeds.

what: After a model change the new table did not exist: relation t_webshop_product_version does not exist; the schema upgrade is not run by judo.sh start.
why: Schema upgrade is a separate step before start.
workaround: Ran schema upgrade before start (per GAPS R18-12).

what: Seed script and shell slips: psql file read ENOENT, /tmp file missing, BSD sed range failed, query command not found in a subshell.
why: Builder shell mistakes on macOS BSD tools.
workaround: Used python for the edit.

what: BooleanFilter.equalTo(true) does not exist in the SDK; isTrue() is the method.
why: Builder guessed the SDK method name; checked with javap.
workaround: Changed to BooleanFilter.isTrue().

what: The kb repeated-search guard fired 42 more times in this part of the chunk, mostly during build and log triage.
why: Guard mis-fires on bulk build and log work; same as R17.
workaround: Ran kb_search when prompted.
